name: create_file
description:
Create, overwrite, or incrementally append UTF-8 plain-text files at the specified path. In restricted mode paths must resolve inside the current registered source scope; allow-all/non-restricted permission modes can use all registered sources, and open mode can also use absolute local paths outside registered sources. Parent directories are created automatically for create/overwrite. Supports text-based formats (md, txt, json, csv, rs, py, etc.). Paths may be absolute or relative to a source root.

Use this tool when:
- You need to create a brand-new text file (mode=create, the default)
- You explicitly need to replace the whole file (mode=overwrite)
- You are continuing a long plain-text write in ordered chunks (mode=append)

Long-write protocol:
1. Write the first coherent chunk with mode=create.
2. Read nextExpectedBytes from the successful tool result.
3. Append each remaining coherent chunk with mode=append, expected_bytes set to that exact byte value, and wait_for_previous=true when calls share an assistant turn.
4. Use the returned nextExpectedBytes for the next chunk. A precondition mismatch means the file changed or a chunk already ran; inspect current state instead of blindly resending.

There is no special UTF-8 'encoding limit' in this tool. The practical constraint is the model/tool-call payload, so keep individual generated chunks reasonably bounded (typically tens of KiB) and continue with append calls. Never tell the user that a long text file could not be written because of an encoding limitation when this chunk protocol is available.

Do not use Python or run_shell snippets for ordinary plain-text file creation or continuation. Do not use this tool for DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF files. Use run_shell + doc-script-editor (Python Office libraries) for Office/PDF creation, validation, conversion, rendering, existing-file edits, extraction, redaction, formula checks, OOXML surgery, or template-preserving work. For generated PPT/PPTX decks, do not use create_file just to stage a transient deck JSON spec; call the PPTX renderer through run_shell with --spec - and pass the spec through stdin.
For targeted edits inside an existing text file, use edit_file instead.
For notes in the notes/ subdirectory, use write_note instead.

path.description: Path to the file (absolute or relative to a source directory; open mode also accepts absolute local paths outside registered sources).

mode.description: Write mode. create is the default and fails if the file exists. overwrite replaces the whole file. append requires an existing file and a matching expected_bytes precondition.

content.description: The UTF-8 text content for this write or append chunk.

expected_bytes.description: Required for mode=append. Exact current file length in UTF-8 bytes, normally copied from the previous result's nextExpectedBytes. Prevents duplicate and out-of-order chunks.

overwrite.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for mode=overwrite. Do not combine it with another explicit mode.
